compute_tapvid3d_metrics: compute TAP-Vid 3D tracking metrics including Jaccard, points within threshold, and occlusion accuracy
create_local_tracks: create local track neighborhoods by gathering points within a threshold distance of ground truth tracks
get_pointwise_threshold_multiplier: get pointwise depth-adaptive threshold multiplier from ground truth tracks and camera intrinsics
compute_occlusion_accuracy: compute occlusion accuracy by comparing predicted occlusions against ground truth occlusion masks
compute_jaccard_metric: compute Jaccard similarity metrics at multiple pixel thresholds for 3D point track evaluation
